risks.title: Cyclical volatility of maritime freight rates
risks.score_rationale: Dominant risk in Item 1A (entire section dedicated), highly intensive language ('cyclical', 'volatile', 'materially adversely affect'), stable but persistent trend, categorically major weight for shipping operations.

risks.title: Dependence on charterers for revenue
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in 'Risks Related to our Business', direct language ('dependent on the ability and willingness'), direct impact on revenue, stable but structural trend to the business.

risks.title: Exposure to volatile spot market and renewal risk
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk related to short-term chartering model, warning language ('adverse impact on revenues'), stable trend, significant weight for financial planning.

risks.title: Fleet aging and technological obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Explicit operational risk ('As our vessels age'), warning language on competitiveness, upward trend (aging vessels), significant weight for renewal strategy.

risks.title: Dependence on manager Brave Maritime
risks.score_rationale: Explicit operational risk ('depend on our manager'), direct but moderate language, stable trend, medium weight for operational continuity.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and maritime route disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Major risk repeated in Item 1A (Ukraine conflict, Iran-Israel, Houthi attacks, sanctions), intensive language ('materially adversely affect'), upward trend (new Red Sea/Suez disruptions), increasing weight.

risks.title: Environmental regulation and ESG compliance
risks.score_rationale: Explicit regulatory risk ('subject to regulation and liability under environmental laws'), mention of ESG importance for clients and financiers, upward trend (tightening standards), increasing weight.

risks.title: Small fleet size and operational capacity constraints
risks.score_rationale: Explicit structural risk ('small size of our fleet'), warning language ('material adverse effect'), stable trend, moderate but strategic weight.
